group_results.reason: A valid .lzma input whose header fits in the first input chunk reaches the added reset during initial dictionary allocation. The recipe includes and links that decoder.

build.reason: The recipe builds static liblzma, places it at the archive path used by the Makefile, and invokes rules that compile and link the fuzz target.

input.reason: The entry supplies generated bytes to the helper, which passes input and output buffers to lzma_code. A first chunk can contain a complete .lzma header.

lifecycle.reason: Each invocation initializes a fresh stream, codes input, and ends the stream. The cleanup chain releases the nested decoder and dictionary.

control_flow.reason: The entry initializes the alone decoder and calls lzma_code. Header parsing selects LZMA1EXT, whose initializer calls the changed LZ decoder initializer.
